description: Weight of TMT bar per meter length. D is diameter in mm. This is the BIS standard formula for calculating the weight of steel reinforcement bars. Derived from volume of cylinder: π/4 × D² × L × density, where density of steel = 7850 kg/m³. For 1m length: (π/4 × D² × 1000 × 7.85) / 1000 = D² / 162.28 kg/m
Weight of steel plate. L, W, T are length, width and thickness in mm. Density of steel = 7.85 g/cm³ = 7850 kg/m³. Convert dimensions to cm, calculate volume, then multiply by density.
Weight of angle section per meter. A and B are leg lengths in mm, T is thickness in mm. This simplified formula approximates the cross-sectional area of the angle section.
Weight of steel channel section varies by section size and standard (ISMC, ISMC etc.). Refer to IS Handbook Table 1 for exact weights per meter.
Weight of flat bar per meter. W is width in mm and T is thickness in mm. Converts dimensions to cm, calculates cross-sectional area, multiplies by density of steel.
